title: Crown Holdings Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call
summary: TAMPA, Fla., Sept. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Crown Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: CCK) will release its earnings for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, after the close of trading on the New York Stock Exchange on Monday, October 19, 2026.
body_markdown:
TAMPA, Fla.


, Sept. 22, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Crown Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: CCK) will release its earnings for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, after the close of trading on the New York Stock Exchange on Monday, October 19, 2026. The Company will hold a conference call to discuss these results at **9:00 a.m. EDT on Tuesday, October 20, 2026.**


The Company invites investors to participate as follows:


**Conference Call Information**


- **Dial-in:** (630) 395-0194
- **Toll-Free:** (888) 324-8108
- **Access Password:** *packaging*


**A live webcast of the call will also be available on the Company's website at**[www.crowncork.com](http://www.crowncork.com/) .


A replay of the conference call will be available for one week, ending at midnight on October 27, 2026.


**Replay Information**


- **Replay Number:** (203) 369-0896
- **Toll-Free Replay:** (866) 427-6407


Crown Holdings, Inc., through its subsidiaries, is a leading global supplier of rigid packaging products to consumer marketing companies, as well as transit and protective packaging products, equipment, and services to a broad range of end markets. The Company's world headquarters are located in Tampa, Florida. Learn more at[www.crowncork.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4780265-1&h=2907904005&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.crowncork.com%2F&a=www.crowncork.com) .


For more information, please contact Corporate Communications at **(215) 602-2653** .
